content.title: About
content.content: Iced green tea in a bottle is a refreshing non‑alcoholic beverage made from green tea leaves that are brewed, filtered, and chilled without any added sugar. It retains the light, vegetal flavor of green tea with a gentle bitterness and a crisp, cooling finish.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green tea is rich in polyphenols, especially epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), known for strong antioxidant activity.
Bottled iced tea is often packaged in clear glass or PET bottles to showcase its clear, bright color.
Being unsweetened, the drink is very low in calories—about 0–5 kcal per 100 ml.
Traditional green tea cultivation originates in China, Japan, and parts of India.
Cooling the tea can accentuate its bitterness, which is why a splash of lemon juice is sometimes added.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Polyphenols in green tea help neutralize free radicals, supporting cellular health.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Caffeine and catechins may modestly boost metabolic rate and aid fat oxidation.

items.title: Improved focus
items.content: A modest caffeine dose enhances alertness and cognitive performance.

items.title: Sugar‑free hydration
items.content: Provides fluid without added calories, making it ideal for hot weather.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Regular moderate consumption of green tea is linked to better lipid profiles and reduced heart disease risk.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: People sensitive to caffeine may experience jitteriness, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Caffeine and polyphenols can affect the action of certain medications, such as blood thinners.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Green tea has mild acidity, which may irritate the stomach of individuals with gastritis or ulcers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the iced green tea chilled; optionally add a lemon wedge or a sprig of mint for extra aroma. It pairs well with light snacks, salads, and seafood dishes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the bottle refrigerated at 2–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days. Protect from prolonged exposure to direct sunlight.
